limitations: These six actual 2023-serving senators were absent from the 39-person historically verified policy-excerpt research corpus at PR #1055.
A current website is a lead only, even where 2022 district branding appears; 2022 archived HTML/capture must be independently proven.
Every CDX index and original HTML replay is bounded; no records, exhausted sample, or transient failure is evidence of no candidate policy.
Dates on original archive captures are verifiable publicly observable BY times, not first author-posted dates.
A policy claim of legislative sponsorship, attendance, roll-call support or bill passage is not itself official legislative vote proof.
No source may be automatically ingested as production evidence and no serving/forecast/model infrastructure is accessed.
